{{Quote|What's wrong with the Rendili ''Battle Horn''-class? It's got the size you want, it's got the speed&mdash;''"<br />"''It's a freighter.''"<br />"''It's a bulk cruiser, not a freighter. It's armed, it's armored, it's got the range, it's got the capacity&mdash;|Jinzler suggesting a ''Battle Horn'' cruiser to Tarkosa before being interrupted by [[Bearsh]]|<ref name="Survive Quest" />}}
The '''''Battle Horn''-class bulk cruiser''' was a model of [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]], and was named for the ''[[Battle Horn]]'', a famous Rendili [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> When [[Dean Jinzler]] was suggesting a list of ships the [[Colonists|group]] of [[Survivors (Outbound Flight)|survivors]] of the [[Outbound Flight Project]] could use to leave the [[Unidentified planetoid (The Redoubt)|planetoid]] on [[The Redoubt/Legends|The Redoubt]], he suggested a ''Battle Horn''-class ship, but [[Brace Tarkosa]] and [[Chas Uliar]] turned it down.<ref name="Survive Quest" />
